org.golfit.client.gui.lobby.LobbyMenu

javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class LobbyMenu extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
Sidebar component for lobby management. Shows either the lobby list (with create/join) or the current lobby view (with player list, stroke counts, start, and leave buttons). Listens to EventBus events for lobby updates, game start/end, and stroke updates.
